entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I hope you can help. I need to return something, and I'm just so sad about it. I ordered the ProFit Jersey and it just arrived.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the fit. I think I must have ordered the wrong size. It's just... it's way too tight across the shoulders. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for five years and I always get a medium, but this one I can't even move in.
I see. So it's a sizing issue, not a problem with the material or zippers or anything like that?
Right. I was so excited for it, and now I just feel deflated. I was really hoping I could exchange it for a bigger size. I really needed this for a charity ride I'm doing.

I completely understand the disappointment. Let's get this sorted out for you. Let me pull up your account. I see you received the order six days ago. Since it's a jersey, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return and exchange period. We can absolutely process an exchange for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it, and I'd be out the money. An exchange would be perfect.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the exchange for you in a size large. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file right now. Just use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and we'll ship the new one as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier.
That is wonderful news. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you have gear that fits perfectly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride!
